title: JAXbounce: A Continuous-Control Pong-Like Benchmark for Active Inference Beyond Low Dimensional Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.28203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce JAXbounce, a continuous control pong-like benchmark designed to evaluate active inference beyond discrete, low dimensional environments. JAXbounce combines continuous states and stochastic dynamics in discrete time with flexible and composable observation models that allow representing the environment as a state vector or a pixel grid, corruptible through the rich family of noise models we provide. It is fully differentiable and parallelisable in JAX. We run over 10,000 agent simulations on our environment comparing a baseline deterministic solution, to a state-based active inference agent with Unscented Kalman Filter perception and expected free energy planning, and a pixel based agent whose measurement model is a pretrained neural network encoder. translated_title: JAXbounce：一个用于超越低维环境的主动推理的连续控制类Pong基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了JAXbounce，这是一个连续控制的类Pong基准测试，旨在评估超越离散、低维环境的主动推理。JAXbounce将离散时间下的连续状态与随机动力学相结合，并配备灵活且可组合的观测模型，允许将环境表示为状态向量或像素网格，且可通过我们提供的丰富噪声模型家族对观测进行扰动。该环境在JAX中完全可微分且可并行化。我们在该环境中运行了超过10,000次智能体模拟，比较了基线确定性解决方案、具有无迹卡尔曼滤波感知和期望自由能规划的基于状态的主动推理智能体，以及以预训练神经网络编码器作为测量模型的基于像素的智能体。所有智能体在三个难度递增的场景和八种不同噪声条件下进行评估。我们的实验刻画了连续状态智能体性能随环境变化的特征。
tldr: 提出了JAXbounce——一个完全可微分、可并行化的连续控制类Pong基准测试，通过状态向量与像素观测、多种噪声条件及超过万次的智能体模拟，将主动推理的评估从低维离散环境拓展到更复杂的高维连续环境。
en_tdlr: JAXbounce is a fully differentiable, parallelisable continuous-control Pong-like benchmark that extends active inference evaluation beyond low-dimensional discrete environments by comparing deterministic, state-based, and pixel-based agents across multiple noise conditions and increasing difficulty scenarios.
